issues.name: Housing Supply
issues.hook: Governor Ferguson’s 2026 request bills included reforms to increase the supply of housing.
sources: Governor Ferguson announces slate of 6 Governor Request Bills for 2026

issues.name: Taxes and Revenue
issues.hook: After the 2026 session Governor Ferguson signed bills that repealed or rolled back taxes enacted a year earlier.
sources: Gov. Ferguson signs series of bills passed during 2026 legislative session (KAFE)

issues.name: Climate and Cap-and-Invest
issues.hook: One signed 2026 bill (HB 2367) exempts emissions from a coal facility before January 1, 2026 from the Cap-and-Invest Program.
sources: Gov. Ferguson signs series of bills passed during 2026 legislative session (KAFE)

issues.name: Parents’ Rights
issues.hook: A rewrite of the parental “bill of rights” stemming from Initiative 2081 was among the bills signed in 2026.
sources: Gov. Ferguson signs series of bills passed during 2026 legislative session (KAFE)
